title: 1954 Atomic Energy Act moved craft custody to contractor-operated labs

tellings.quote: different mind. I think that craft was moved in 1954 because the 1954 atomic energy agreement gave expanded powers to government-owned contractor operated laboratories like Sandia and so forth to house the craft.

plain: A researcher known online as UAPGerb told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he believes a recovered craft was moved in 1954. His reasoning is that the Atomic Energy Act of that year gave new powers to laboratories owned by the government but run by private companies, like Sandia, a national weapons lab, which let them house such craft. If true, it would explain how recovered objects ended up outside direct government control.
